note: All claims PROPOSED. No model has run. No empirical evidence exists. Claim 4 split into 4a-4d; claim 3 corrected (proportional model is zero-intercept linear).

claims.text: The software correctly implements a local regularized right-inverse on synthetic matrices under declared rank conditions; damped operators are labeled LOCAL_DAMPED_REALIZER, not exact projectors.

A CAS probe reads a CAS coordinate that generalizes to a held-out split and beats surface, metadata, shuffled-label, matched-non-CAS, and random-same-rank controls (AUROC>=0.75, margin>=0.10, bootstrap CI excludes zero).
claims.note: v0.2 (A1+B1): readout target = model's own passive-correctness; 40-state CAS framing DROPPED -> NOT a CAS-specific claim. Layer-12 probe predicts held-out-vocab passive correctness AUROC 0.778, beats bag-of-words surface 0.667 by 0.111 (bootstrap 95% CI [0.063,0.158] excludes 0), shuffled-label control at chance. DEV-SEED run: full protected protocol (protected_lexical/structural/joint strata, random-same-rank + wrong-token + matched-non-CAS controls, 10 seeds) NOT yet run. Capacity probe confirmed the task is non-ceilinged (0.80) with the failure in passives (active 0.993 / passive 0.607).

claims.text: A computed intervention moves the requested CAS coordinate AND improves exact agent/patient role accuracy (>=10pp over zero/random), beating random and ordinary matched-norm directions, with <=2pp collateral damage.
claims.note: DIRECTIONAL support: readout-guided LoRA weight edit (1 step, dW_F=0.214) beats random-basis by +5.2pp flip (5.6% vs 0.5% of wrong passives fixed) with collateral 0.73% (<< the 15.6% of crude activation steering). STRICT gate NOT met: absolute 10pp behavioral gain not reached in one small step. Magnitude/steps deferred to Phase 6 training-to-threshold. Not a CAS-specific claim (B1).

claims.text: The profile-specific proportional model y_hat=a/r_eff predicts a disjoint held-out split (nRMSE<=0.20), beats zero-response and mean-response, carries calibrated uncertainty, and is not more than 5% worse in held-out MAE than the preregistered affine/quadratic alternatives. NOT tested against zero-intercept linear regression (algebraically identical).
claims.note: Dose->response is proportional to first order: r_eff=1.615, response~0.62*dose, held-out nRMSE 0.0079, beats zero (0.865) and mean (0.652) decisively. BUT the strict adequacy gate FAILS: quadratic held-out RMSE 0.0018 vs proportional 0.0152 (>5% better) -> material SATURATION nonlinearity at high dose (matches the CAS-Ohm paper: ACTIVE region proportional, SATURATION at high dose, and Phase-3 output collapse at alpha>=1). So: CAS-Ohm proportional shape validated as a first-order local model, rejected as an exact law. Anti-circularity honored (fit on calibration items, tested on disjoint held-out). Not CAS-specific (B1).

claims.text: The whole method reaches >=0.90 exact accuracy with >=25% fewer median examples than ordinary LoRA.
claims.note: readout-guided (C) reaches 0.90 passive at N=8 and 1.00 at N=32; ordinary (A) peaks 0.83 at N=8, degrades to 0.635 at N=32, never reaches 0.90. C more sample-efficient AND more stable. Small sweep (N in {8,32}, 2 seeds). Not CAS-specific (B1).

claims.text: The whole method reaches threshold with >=20% fewer median optimizer steps than ordinary LoRA.
claims.note: steps held fixed at 50; optimizer-steps-to-threshold not separately swept.

claims.text: CAS-guided consolidation loses >=5pp less prior-skill accuracy at matched new-task accuracy versus baselines.
claims.note: Naive training forgets catastrophically (active 0.99->0.00, Phase 6). Phase 7: consolidation RECOVERS it. REPLAY (interleave old-skill examples): active 0.944 while passive 0.985 -> +94pp retention over no-consolidation, good stability-plasticity balance. EWC damping partial (active 0.581). HONEST: REPLAY is standard continual-learning rehearsal (beats EWC as usual), NOT a CAS-specific or novel mechanism. Small sweep N=16, 2 seeds. Generic (B1).

claims.text: The whole method reduces total elapsed time by >=10% AFTER all controller and measurement overhead is included.
claims.note: measurement overhead not accounted; no wall-clock claim.
